method: Existing whole-patch raster deformation, explicitly ambient motion. Original crops remain the appearance authority. No generated art, no rejected object frames, no character animation, no crossfades.
palette: GIF previews use a single 256-color palette per loop. Godot uses lossless RGB PNG cells to preserve the exact source border and baseline.

tests.meadow_paving_and_top_96_rows: PASS; exact RGB in all 32 frames

acceptance_gaps: Target Lenovo M11/older Android timing and overdraw
edge_treatment: Transparent 14px guard within the unchanged 16px border. Every moving pixel remains fully opaque; fixed RGB paint is preserved under the guard.
license: Project-owned art from canonical ASSET_LICENSES.md. New derivatives retain source licensing and candidate status.
timing_record_limit: No separate active-authoring/cleanup stopwatch. Machine logs are retained without inventing manual time.
source_acceptance: Approved v5 panorama; derivatives are unaccepted ambient study candidates.
